text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — Grafana shows a sharp spike in spot interruption-rate for the us-west2 GPU pool over the last 12m. Interruption rate peaked at ~8% (baseline ~0.7%). p95 latency for gen-api up ~40ms and a few 500s from fallback logic.

oncall-bot: ALERT: spot_interruption_rate > 5% (us-west2-gpu) — PagerDuty alert triggered. See https://grafana.redwood.com/d/spot/availability?orgId=1&var-region=us-west2

Gonzalo: thanks, Priya. Is this across all a100 SKUs or specific preemptible sizes?

Priya Rao: Mainly a100-preemptible and a100-small-preemptible. Provider capacity signal shows "reduction" for these SKUs. Other heterogeneous pools (g5) look stable.

Marta: Any immediate mitigation we can flip? Can we auto-promote requests to on-demand or fallback pool earlier?

Gonzalo: I can change the routing policy to prefer dedicated for routes with latency-sensitive SLOs. Recommend: if interruption_rate > 2% for 5m, switch route to dedicated and increase dedicated capacity by 10% for 15m.

Priya Rao: +1. Also lowering batch sizes for gen-api to reduce tail latency while capacity is noisy.

Gonzalo: I'll patch the rollout policy: set fallback_threshold=2% and temp_dedicated_boost=10%. Pushing now.

DevOps-Bot: deploy:rollout-policy updated by Gonzalo — rollback in 20m if errors. (ref: infra/rollouts/489)

Marta: Can someone create a short dashboard panel that shows interruption-rate, provider_signals, and 'promoted-to-dedicated' count side-by-side? Makes triage faster.

Priya Rao: I'll add a tile and a simple alert rule tweak. Also created a runbook note: 'if provider signal shows sustained reduction + interruption >2% for 10m — escalate to infra oncall and open capacity request with cloud sales rep.'

Gonzalo: Filing a short post-action item list in #incidents after this settles. For now tracking: adjust alerts, boost dedicated, reduce batch size, monitor.

Marta: Assigning follow-ups: Priya -> dashboard + runbook update, Gonzalo -> rollout policy and capacity request, I'll own post-incident notes. :white_check_mark:

Priya Rao: Thanks — monitoring closely. Ping me if you see more 5xxs.
